label: v4 roadmap (the robot's map; it knows the roads, never goal B). Read by the v4 controller (hri_control_v4.py, through control.json -> roadmap) and by the Unity v4 scene builder, so both use the same nodes. The v3 map configs/roadmap.json is unchanged.
declared: 2026-11-12 by Nusrat during Anisha's absence (P7, P8; Avatar/Config/upgrade_design.md section 6; AUDIT.md section 15), before any run on it. Positions in the open aisles of the generated warehouse (rack centres at x = -12.5, 0, 12.5 and z = -15, -5, 5, 15; walls near +-26 m).
frame: Unity floor coordinates x, z in m (y up). Branch commands are relative to the arrival direction (previous node -> junction; at the start node its start heading start_yaw_deg), from the robot's point of view.

worker_stand.rule: The worker stands corner_offset_m ahead and corner_offset_m to the right of the node (arrival direction; at the start node the start heading), facing the arriving robot. Unity scenario side only; the robot finds the worker by vision.

route_lengths_note: Along the roads from A; reported only (the trail is scored against the grid's optimal corridor, gt_path.py). The longest, 65.0 m, is L_max of the timeout rule (upgrade_design.md section 6).
